rows.note: Use this as the usual noun for a defect or imperfection, especially one that is not immediately obvious.

example.english: This phone has a hidden flaw, but it keeps crashing when I use it.
example.traditional: 呢部手機表面睇唔出有瑕疵，但用落成日死機。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 sau2 gei1 biu2 min6 tai2 m4 ceot1 jau5 haa4 ci1 daan6 jung6 lok6 seng4 jat6 sei2 gei1

rows.note: Use this for the physical crack, fissure, or gap in an object rather than for a general imperfection.

example.english: There is a flaw in the form of a crack in the tabletop, so don't put anything so heavy on it.
example.traditional: 張枱面有條裂縫，唔好再擺咁重嘅嘢喺上面。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 ci4 min6 jau5 tiu4 lit6 fung6 m4 hou2 zoi3 baai2 gam3 cung5 ge3 je5 hai2 soeng6 min6
